2026-11-18-item-3-bc7-axis.webp | The sample's ringed albedo as drawn, on the left, as the BC7 encoder wrote it with its power iteration started at (1, 1, 1, 1), in the middle, each block flat at its mean and 23.70 dB over the picture, and as it writes it started from the column of the channel that varies most, on the right, 34.30 dB, the whole picture above and its top-left block below, where Modeling's carpet holds at 45.27 dB and its wallpaper goes from 46.15 to 46.16.
2026-11-18-item-3-prototype-tables.webp | The seven prototypes of the module's one table, a meter's cell of the grid at 256 pixels tinted in linear light, floor, wall and ceiling one near white at sRGB 0.90, stairs orange, door green, window blue and hazard red, over a grid whose face is 0.99, its lines 0.6 and its quarters' lines 0.82.
2026-11-18-item-3-split-sum-fit.webp | Karis's fit of the split sum against the split sum integrated by importance sampling, the share of the light from all around a surface reflects toward the eye, roughness 0 to 1 across and the cosine to the eye from 1 at the top to 0 at the bottom, a dielectric of f0 0.04 above and a white metal of f0 1 below, the difference red where the fit is higher and blue where it is lower, full at 0.049 above and 0.415 below. The dielectric's largest difference is 0.084, at a roughness and a cosine of 0.12, and over the hits of rays arriving at random, whose cosine has a density of twice itself, its mean is 0.0067 with 15.8% of the hits past 0.01. The metal's largest is 0.509, at a roughness of 0.99 seen at a cosine of 0.008, its mean over the hits 0.10 with 95.6% past 0.01, the fit holding 0.45 at a roughness of one where the integral worked by hand gives 0.3069 head on.

2026-11-22-item-4-spheres.webp | Fourteen spheres lit by one light and a sky, drawn on the CPU by the response in the library, a dielectric in red above and a metal in gold below, their roughness from 0.08 on the left to 1 on the right, so the highlight is seen to widen and fade.
